Ringsted is a municipality in Denmark that is tracked within the national healthcare system's quality monitoring initiatives. Specifically, it is featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. 

The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across the country, utilizing registry data to measure key performance indicators [^src1]. Ringsted's local data concerning stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant therapy [^src1]. This municipal-level data, presented on page 94 of the report, allows for detailed benchmarking and local quality development across all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1].
